summary: A K-guard companion that separates kneeling, combat-base and standing entries from later offense and troubleshooting.
description: Find the relevant K-guard entry block within Lachlan Giles’s No Gi Open Guard Volume 1: K Guard.
overview: The release title says Volume 1, but its player outline contains eight volumes. Early material locates K guard within a wider open-guard approach; later blocks separate entries by opponent posture and then develop offense.

guide.display_title: Lachlan Giles: K-Guard Entries and Offense

fits: You want to compare K-guard entries against different opponent postures without jumping directly to the finishing sections.
consider_alternative_if: If passes around or under your legs are the main problem before offense begins, compare the Giles–Tabak retention guide.

includes: Open-guard context and K-guard controls; entries against kneeling, combat-base and standing opponents.
Retention entries, offensive pathways, counter responses and narrated material.
limits: Lower-body offense is a substantial part of the syllabus; this is broader than a short introduction to one guard entry.

start_here.title: Choose the posture-specific entry block
start_here.task: Find your opponent’s posture in the outline: kneeling in volume 4, or combat base/standing in volume 5. Pair that block with the general entry discussion in volume 3. When reviewing an exchange, note the posture before the entry attempt and whether it changes; do not infer the entry mechanics from the chapter name.
